notes.title: Conduit 4.0 — works wherever you are
notes.intro: This is the biggest release since Conduit began. Your chats now live on your device first, and Conduit can talk to more than one kind of backend — including no backend at all.

bullets.text: Offline persistence: chats, notes, and drafts are stored on device and sync when you reconnect. Read and search your history anywhere — messages you send offline are queued and delivered automatically.
Hermes Agent: connect a self-hosted Hermes server as a second backend, with live tool progress, approval prompts before sensitive actions, scheduled agents, and slash-command skills.
Direct connections: chat with OpenAI-compatible providers and local Ollama models straight from the app — no Open WebUI server required. Bring your own API key, or none at all.
Sharper everywhere: smoother streaming and scrolling, refined sheets and navigation, and fixes across attachments, speech, and theming.
